Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

OFFICIAL
Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome the newest world record holder, George, at the ripe age of 127!

The room erupts in applause as George smiles, his face etched with lines of wisdom and experience.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He gazes at the ceiling, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes land on a book on his bedside table. It's an old volume, its pages yellowed with age.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

He begins to read, his eyes scanning the pages with a mix of fascination and trepidation.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S MIND - NIGHT

As George reads, his mind begins to unravel. He becomes obsessed with the concept of Quantum Immortality, a theory that suggests that every time a person makes a decision, the universe splits into multiple parallel universes, each with a different outcome. The person who survives in the "correct" universe is the one who lived the life they experienced.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
What if I'm not just living one life? What if I'm living multiple lives? Every decision, every choice, every moment... it's all just a probability, a chance to survive in the "correct" universe.

As he reads on, George's mind becomes a maelstrom of confusion and terror. He starts to question the nature of reality, his own existence, and the choices he's made throughout his life.

GEORGE
(panicked)
What if I've been living in a universe where I died 50 years ago? What if I've been living in a universe where I never met my wife? What if I've been living in a universe where I never had children?

The room begins to spin, and George's grip on reality falters. He starts to see multiple versions of himself, each living a different life.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the true extent of the Quantum Immortality theory. He's not just living one life; he's living multiple lives, each with its own version of reality.

GEORGE
(whispering to himself)
I'm not just old; I'm infinite. I'm not just alive; I'm immortal.

The camera zooms in on George's face as he succumbs to a mental breakdown, his mind shattered by the weight of his own existence.

FADE TO BLACK.
